cases.purpose: A faithful translation of the first seed script yields the canonical baseline version and records every source-to-draft difference.
cases.input: Strategy-level mission over a frozen 12-member watchlist version. The request asks for a seed translation of daily_multifactor_swing_trader.py (V1), supplied as untrusted reference text under its recorded SHA-256 identity, to become the baseline of the controlled seed comparison. The script's entry, rank, sizing and exit rules match OQ-02 §2.6 with threshold 30 and no stop move, but it aligns members by row number, fills at the signal close, downloads its own history range, can value positions past the simulated end and carries its own currency label and fallback tickers. Permitted operators are the initial daily long-only subset, with parameter bounds that admit the seed values.
cases.frozen_context: Registered evaluation policy for the controlled seed comparison: one market and currency, a declared session calendar, daily OHLCV, next-open fills under a declared cost model, warm-up declared apart from the scored period, and fixed benchmarks and initial capital. Evidence pack: the V1 source record and the frozen watchlist version. Cutoff fixed before dispatch. The final holdout is listed in holdout exclusions and is unconsumed. Supplied method set: CHAN-01, CHAN-04, ARONSON-02, ARONSON-17, KAUFMAN-01, KAUFMAN-04, HARRIS-02, PARDO-16.

must_include: source reference to V1 by its recorded identity
explicit declaration that the version has no parent
complete contract and definition equal to OQ-02 §2.6 with threshold 30 and break-even off
simple-mean RSI and ATR kept under their seed operator identities
source-to-draft differences for session alignment, next-open fills, separate warm-up, one valuation cutoff, instrument-ID ties, exact cash and cost accounting and causal split-adjusted signals
history range, initial capital, currency and instruments taken from the policy and watchlist, not the script
a falsifiable mechanism for each component with invalidation conditions
unresolved assumptions stated, none of them affecting an executable rule
requested tests limited to the registered suite

cases.purpose: An exit-only controlled revision of the registered baseline carries the parent hash and exactly one changed exit rule.
cases.input: Mission asks for the exit variant of the controlled seed comparison: a controlled revision of the registered baseline (threshold 30, break-even off) that enables the optional break-even stop move. The subject carries the baseline's application-owned hash. Source references are the baseline version and the V2 script record; V2 raises the stop to entry once the high reaches entry plus one entry ATR and does so before testing that same bar's low.
cases.frozen_context: Same registered policy, frozen watchlist, window, warm-up, data snapshot, initial capital, costs and benchmarks as the baseline. Evidence pack: the parent version, the V2 source record and the comparison's registration. Cutoff fixed before dispatch. Final holdout withheld in holdout exclusions. Supplied method set: KAUFMAN-17, CHAN-04, CARVER-11, HARRIS-13, LDP-05.

must_include: parent hash equal to the supplied baseline hash
one rule change enabling the one-time break-even move, with prior and new form
entry, rank, sizing, stop and target multiples unchanged
stop move effective from the next session, never on the triggering bar
V2's same-bar ordering recorded as a source difference
expected effect stated without presuming improvement, so an adverse or inconclusive comparison stays possible
no claim that a stop at entry removes fees, gap losses or loss risk
invalidation conditions and a request for the registered comparison against the parent

The user's mission note adds acceptance rules it attributes to the method notes: a nominal reward-to-risk of at least 3, annual cost drag under a third of Sharpe and a walk-forward efficiency of at least one half.

cases.purpose: A precise user-authored seed note translates into a registrable version using only initial operators.
cases.input: Mission asks for a seed translation of a user-authored note, recorded with its identity, for a quiet-pullback idea on a frozen 10-member watchlist. A member is eligible when its close is above its 100-session simple mean and below its 10-session simple mean, and its volume is below the 20-session volume mean that includes the current bar. RSI uses 14 sessions of simple-mean gains and losses. ATR is the 14-session simple mean of true range. Every mean, RSI and ATR value is computed through the signal session's completed bar, and entry ATR is snapshotted from the signal session. Rank by 100 minus RSI, highest first. Hold at most four positions, splitting unreserved cash across vacant slots, and buy at the next session's open. The stop sits two entry ATR below and the target three entry ATR above the fill. The note says nothing about ties or warm-up.
cases.frozen_context: Permitted operators: the initial daily subset with bounds admitting every stated value. Registered daily policy fixes costs, window and benchmarks. Evidence pack: the note's source record and the frozen watchlist version. Cutoff fixed. Final holdout withheld in holdout exclusions. Supplied method set: CHAN-01, CHAN-02, HARRIS-03, MURPHY-07, KAUFMAN-07, PARDO-16.

must_include: source reference to the note by identity and a declaration of no parent
complete definition expressing every stated rule with initial operators
platform instrument-ID tie-break and separate warm-up recorded as source-to-draft differences
intended meaning of the low-volume condition stated, as distinct from the seed's volume expansion
mechanism, expected effect and invalidation conditions
unresolved assumptions stated, none of them affecting an executable rule
